name: opencode-loop-recover
description: Loop guard for OpenCode: detects model repetition mid-stream, interrupts, prunes the poisoned context, and resumes the task automatically.

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/server.js').then(m => { const d = m.default; if (!d || !d.id || typeof d.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('default {id,setup} 缺失'); console.log('OK', d.id) })"
